name: mac-hud
title: Mac HUD
description: The macOS volume and brightness overlay: a frosted, click-through HUD in the classic 200×200 square or the macOS 26 pill. Repeat changes update it in place and restart its 1.1s hold; it never replays its entrance.
docs: Import MacHud and useMacHud from components/eased/mac-hud/mac-hud. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Call show(kind, value) from useMacHud() and spread hud onto <MacHud>. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark". In a Tauri or Electron window with native vibrancy, pass material="native".
